rationale: Create one canonical UGI Utilities – Electric Division record for the separable regulated Pennsylvania electric transmission-and-distribution business. UGI Utilities, Inc. remains the current legal owner. Funds managed by Argo Infrastructure Partners LP signed an approximately $470 million definitive agreement on April 28, 2026, but UGI's August 2026 Form 10-Q continued to classify the business as held for sale and expected closing in UGI fiscal Q2 2027, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals. Record Argo only in one SIGNED_PENDING_INCOMING transaction and create no active Argo ownership period before legal closing. Count the electric utility once and exclude UGI's gas division, UGI Corporation, generation businesses, individual lines and substations and Wyoming Valley Electric acquisition entities as separate PortCos. No legal close, termination, resale, replacement buyer or revised timetable was identified through August 16, 2026.

afterImage.name: UGI Utilities – Electric Division
afterImage.description: UGI Utilities – Electric Division is a regulated electric transmission, distribution and retail utility serving more than 63,000 customers in Luzerne and Wyoming counties in northeastern Pennsylvania. The business operates approximately 2,700 miles of transmission and distribution lines and 14 substations. UGI Utilities, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of UGI Corporation, remains the current legal owner. Funds managed by Argo Infrastructure Partners LP signed an approximately $470 million definitive purchase agreement on April 28, 2026, but UGI's August 2026 Form 10-Q continued to classify the business as held for sale and expected closing in UGI fiscal Q2 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and applicable regulatory approvals. The exact Argo fund, manager-level stake, standalone legal suffix, headquarters, founding year and separate website are not publicly disclosed. Wyoming Valley Electric Holdings LLC and related acquisition entities are transaction vehicles for this same target, not separate PortCos. No legal close, termination, resale or revised timetable was identified through August 16, 2026.

milestones.event: UGI Utilities announced a definitive agreement to sell its Pennsylvania Electric Division to funds managed by Argo Infrastructure Partners LP for approximately $470 million, subject to closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
UGI Utilities, Inc. and Wyoming Valley Electric Holdings LLC filed their joint Federal Power Act section 203 application in FERC docket EC26-118-000.
UGI's fiscal 2026 third-quarter Form 10-Q continued to classify the electric utility as held for sale and expected closing in UGI fiscal Q2 2027, confirming the Argo acquisition remained pending.
